content: ChatGPT Plus quota semantics: No public API exposes Plus subscription remaining messages/quota. Reset semantics are PER-MODEL, not account-wide, and use THREE mechanisms: (1) rolling windows starting from your first message (GPT-5/4o: 3-hour rolling; Codex: 5-hour windows + weekly caps per cline issue #8910), (2) daily 00:00 UTC fixed resets (o4-mini 300/day), (3) weekly rolling 7-day from first use (o3: 100/week). OpenAI shows reset time ONLY in the model picker UI ('Limit resets at 3:47 PM') and only after you've started using a model or hit a limit. Reset time is server-provided, not locally computed. A fixed '168-hour cycle from an anchor' assumption is fragile: the 168h cycle is only valid for o3-style weekly models, not GPT-5/4o rolling or o4-mini daily. Community trackers (oc-chatgpt-multi-auth) store rateLimitResetTimes from API/headers rather than computing them.
